kālacīvara.p: [Kāla+cīvara] (na) CL=7 The robe material is given during the appointed period (to be used and allotted by the saṅgha). (Before Kathina, a period starts from 1st waning day of the third month of Hemanta to the full moon day of the fourth month of Hemanta. The period of a robe that is the Kathina ceremony during the period starts from the 1st waning day of the third month of Hamenta to the full moon day of the fourth month of Gimhāna. (Offering the robe during this period is called Kālacīvara).
